findings.highlight: enemies will not attack you as long as you stay on your home ground
findings.evidenceJa: ホームグランドにいる限り、敵は簡単には襲いかかってこない
findings.governingReading: On a magus’s home ground, enemies cannot attack easily or casually.
findings.explanation: Will not attack turns a tactical deterrent into categorical safety, which Shirou’s mere alarm boundary does not justify.

findings.evidenceJa: 吐きだされる白い吐息
findings.governingReading: Their exhaled breath is visibly white in the winter air.
findings.explanation: Cold breath replaces a concrete visual image with a temperature property.

findings.highlight: a knife is pushed right against my naked chest
findings.evidenceJa: むき出しの腹に、ピタリと包丁を押し当てられている感覚
findings.governingReading: The killing presence feels like a knife pressed flush against Shirou’s exposed abdomen.
findings.explanation: Chest changes the precise vulnerable body location in the fear image.

findings.evidenceJa: しかし、それも僅かな物だろう
findings.governingReading: Rin has enough room to ready herself, though probably only by a slight margin.
findings.explanation: Come to nothing predicts futility rather than limiting the degree of composure she retains.

findings.highlight: You should work it out if I make that ‘Illyasviel von Einzbern’.
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤスフィール・フォン・アインツベルンって言えばわかるでしょ？
findings.governingReading: Illya says Rin should recognize her when she gives the full name Illyasviel von Einzbern.
findings.explanation: The English is grammatically incoherent and does not express name-based recognition.

findings.highlight: My body is numb, but maybe that’s why my mind is so calm.
findings.evidenceJa: 体は麻痺しているクセに、頭だけは冷静に働くのか
findings.governingReading: Despite his paralyzed body, only Shirou’s head may still be working calmly.
findings.explanation: That’s why turns the concessive mismatch into a causal claim that paralysis produces calm thought.

findings.evidenceJa: 鮮血が散っていく。その中で
findings.governingReading: Fresh blood scatters through the air or scene; amid it, Saber rises.
findings.explanation: Pool invents accumulated blood on the ground and changes a dynamic visual transition into a static location.

findings.highlight:
I don’t even need to say who the ones getting killed are.
Saber will be killed right here.
findings.evidenceJa: 倒されるのが誰かは言うまでもない。彼女はここで殺される。
findings.governingReading: It is obvious who will be defeated: Saber will be killed here.
findings.explanation: The ones getting killed makes the referent plural before the next sentence identifies the singular Saber, momentarily including Shirou and Rin and breaking number agreement.
